spec: §15 suite A (hostcall); §10 hostcall: request bytes copied from one live allocation, reply written to [ptr, ptr+min(len, reply length)), rlen = the full reply length
derivation: host allocates 3 bytes at heap_base 16, stores a5 at byte 0, so the request payload is a5 00 00 with capacity 3; the 5-byte reply 11 22 33 44 55 writes only 3 bytes but rlen is the full 5.
